name: appointment-record
title: Appointment and movement record
for_each: select id,code from appointments order by code

sections.title: Observed movements
sections.note: Timestamps in this section are UTC. Excess time is for contract review, not an invoice or finding of liability.

sections.title: Decision history
sections.sql: select kind,actor,evidence,created_at from events where appointment_id=$1 order by created_at

name: shift-handover
title: Dock shift handover
for_each: select id,code from sites order by code

sections.title: Site instructions
sections.sql: select name,timezone,traffic_plan,review_due from sites where id=$1

sections.title: Open appointments
sections.sql: select a.code,a.dock,a.carrier,a.local_start,a.status,a.owner from v_appointments a join docks d on d.id=a.dock_id where d.site_id=$1 and a.status in ('requested','scheduled','arrived','in_progress') order by a.starts_at

sections.title: Exception handover
sections.sql: select x.code,x.reason,x.detail from v_attention x join appointments a on a.id=x.id join docks d on d.id=a.dock_id where d.site_id=$1 order by x.reason,x.code
